text:
sam: Heads-up — Node SDK v1.8.0 in JSON mode intermittently returns tool/function-call output wrapped in an array when the schema expects an object. Seen this hitting the samplekit onboarding flow.

maria: repro steps? logs?

sam: Quick repro: run samplekit fncall sample that uses jsonSchema for tool output. Intermittent. Code we call: ```js
await client.call({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  mode: 'json',
  function: 'extract_metadata',
  jsonSchema: extractSchema,
  input: promptText
})
```
Sometimes response body is `[{"metadata": {...}}]` instead of `{"metadata": {...}}`. Parser then errors in app code.

deploy-bot: :warning: New error logged (count=3) — parse_error in samplekit-onboard, service=dev-sampleapp

ira: Is this the old auth/retry double-encode pattern or something in the streaming parser? We saw array wrapping in a retry path before.

josh: I can repro reliably on Node but not on Python SDK v0.9.x. That suggests an SDK parity bug. Likely in the Node retry/serialize layer.

maria: Stack trace from samplekit: ```TypeError: Cannot read property 'metadata' of undefined
    at /src/worker/handler.js:42:24
    at async processCall (/src/runner/index.js:88:5)```

sam: Repro notes: happens more when requests are retried (transient 502s). If you force a retry it becomes ~100% in my run.

tina: Could be the response body being concatenated from multiple streaming frames then accidentally wrapped when re-parsing. Another vector is the retry wrapper calling JSON.parse twice on a chunk and wrapping result in an array to preserve fragments — bad.

maria: Temporary workaround for customers: normalize after parse: `if (Array.isArray(parsed)) parsed = parsed[0]` when jsonMode + expected object. We'll add that to samplekit until SDK fix lands.

ira: Plan: maria to open a patch in node-sdk to normalize the shape when json mode + fncall and schema expects object, add tests; josh to add integration test against samplekit that simulates flaky network; tina to help review streaming parser changes. Also add a metric `jsonmode.array_wrap_count`.

maria: Opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/789 — adds normalization + e2e. Will add unit tests that simulate retry double-parse. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

josh: Great. Add changelog entry and a small migration note for samplekit users.

sam: @ira can you write a short release note / customer-facing blurb so support can triage tickets? :thumbsup:

ira: Yep, I'll draft one and post to #support after PR merges. Also adding a temporary samplekit linter rule that flags `jsonMode: true` without a defensive shape-check.

maria: Thanks — I'll include a test case that reproduces the exact array-wrapped output to prevent regressions.

sam: If anyone wants to help validate the fix against our internal flaky env, ping me and I'll give access.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: CI job samplekit/onboard-e2e failed -> rerun queued

josh: Also thinking long-term: SDK should prefer strict schema validation and auto-coerce single-element arrays when safe. We'll discuss RFC after this patch.

maria: PR updated, added unit tests and one flaky e2e repro. Putting in review.

sam: Awesome — thanks all.

(ends)
